object_description: campus of three school buildings and a kindergarten volume
design_condition: The buildings are distributed along the perimeter to create visual transparency between the green corridor and the surrounding streets, structuring the open spaces as a campus.

positive.statement: The three buildings create an interesting spatial transparency and take up the spacious visual references of the garden-city context.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views show three distributed volumes framing transparent open space.

positive.statement: The significant volumes fit comfortably into the context and structure the open spaces in a campus-like manner.

position.rationale: Separated rectangular masses visibly structure open areas across the campus.

positive.statement: The roof terrace successfully combines the spatial and shady potential of the photovoltaic systems with a roof garden open for school use.

position.rationale: Central building roof surface is visible; terrace and photovoltaic arrangement are not individually distinguishable.

positive.statement: The sensible construction takes comprehensive ecological responsibility into account.

position.rationale: Construction responsibility is a non-local performance judgment without a specific geometric referent.

positive.statement: The roof landscape, vertical greenery and diverse vegetation types contribute to sustainability and biodiversity.

position.rationale: Upper surfaces and building edges provide approximate anchors, but vegetation types are not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The project has been developed in an interesting way and shows an appealing overall quality based on clever urban planning.

position.rationale: Overall planning quality concerns the visibly distributed campus composition.

negative.statement: A clearer hierarchy of entrances and a more appropriate definition of the arrival side are desirable.

position.rationale: A plausible perimeter arrival zone is anchored along the near campus edge; entrances are not identifiable.

negative.statement: The rectangular playing fields do not fit convincingly with the organic shapes of the green edge.

position.rationale: A small rectangular ground-level zone is visible near the lower-left campus edge.

negative.statement: Distributing the uses across different buildings leaves possible synergies unused and creates considerable additional operational effort.

position.rationale: Three separate sampled volumes visibly support the distributed-use criticism.

negative.statement: The large number of entrances makes orientation difficult.

position.rationale: Perimeter access is approximated on an outer facade because individual entrances are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The primary school does not implement the required cluster formation typologically.

position.rationale: Central school volume is a plausible anchor, while internal cluster typology is absent from exterior points.

negative.statement: The classrooms have an unfavorable ratio of room height to room depth.

position.rationale: Mid-height central volume approximates classroom locations; room depth and height are not directly resolved.

negative.statement: The development of the triple gymnasium is very complex and operationally difficult.

position.rationale: The largest central volume is a plausible gymnasium anchor, though its program is not identifiable.

negative.statement: The entrances and connections do not sufficiently take school operations into account.

position.rationale: Approximate circulation is placed in the shared ground-level space between distributed buildings.

negative.statement: The mezzanine uses have unsuitable room proportions and are unthinkable in this combination.

position.rationale: Mid-level elevation bands provide a constrained mezzanine anchor in the central building.

negative.statement: The kindergarten is spread over two floors and lacks open space for the upper-floor classes.

position.rationale: Small lower-left volume is a plausible kindergarten location; upper-floor open space is not distinguishable.
